body.condition: \(K_{\ell}(\pi)\ge 2\) for every \(\ell\in\{1,\ldots,L\}\) and every strict priority order \(\pi\) on \(V\).

novel.justification: The condition is equivalent to the conflict graph having no universal vertex and is satisfied by experiments spanning at least two disconnected villages or communities, since each component contributes a focal unit.
